proof_origin: Stage-3 decomposition of podIntegralHomComparison_laws (lem-pod-derived-automorphism-hom-evaluation, steps 8--11): its transpose field, proved formally from parameter naturality and the naturality of the canonical integral tensor comparison (Stacks 0GMX).
title: Preservation of integral tensor-Hom transposition.
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ an isomorphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Write $F=Lg^*$, $T$ and $H$ for the integral constructible pullback, tensor and internal Hom on its permitted Hom pairs [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], $\mu_{L,M}:F(T(L,M))\cong T(FL,FM)$ for the canonical integral pullback-tensor comparison [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-construction], and $c_P:F H(P)\to H(FP)$ for the evaluation-defined comparison between the completed integral partial closed data on $Y$ and $X$, $c_P=\operatorname{tr}_X(\mu^{-1}\circ F(\mathrm{ev}_P))$ [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps, def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces]; a permitted pair $P=(M,N)$ pulls back to a permitted pair $FP$ [lem-pod-reindexing-hom-coefficient-descent]. Then for every $L$, every permitted pair $P=(M,N)$ on $Y$ and every $f:T(L,M)\to N$, $\operatorname{tr}_X(F(f)\circ\mu_{L,M}^{-1})=c_P\circ F(\operatorname{tr}_Y f)$.

lean.statement:
theorem podIntegralHomComparison_transpose :
    ∀ (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
      (P : (constructibleIntegralHomPairs l E Y).FullSubcategory)
      (f : (constructibleIntegralTensor l E Y).obj (L, P.obj.1.unop) ⟶ P.obj.2),
      (podIntegralClosed l E X).transpose _ _
          ((canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E g L P.obj.1.unop).inv ≫
            (constructibleIntegralPullback l E g).map f) =
        (constructibleIntegralPullback l E g).map
            ((podIntegralClosed l E Y).transpose L P f) ≫
          podPartialHomComparison (podIntegralClosed l E Y) (podIntegralClosed l E X)
      (constructibleIntegralPullback l E g) (podIntegralPairs_pullback l E g)
        (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E g) P

proof.text: Put $t=\operatorname{tr}_Y f$. By definition $c_P=\operatorname{tr}_X(\mu^{-1}\circ F(\mathrm{ev}_P))$ [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps], so parameter naturality on $X$ [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces] gives $c_P\circ F(t)=\operatorname{tr}_X(F(\mathrm{ev}_P)\circ\mu^{-1}_{H(P),M}\circ T(Ft,1))$.
The comparison $\mu$ is the component of a natural isomorphism [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso], so $\mu^{-1}_{H(P),M}\circ T(Ft,1)=F(T(t,1))\circ\mu^{-1}_{L,M}$.
By parameter naturality on $Y$, $\mathrm{ev}_P\circ T(t,1)=\operatorname{tr}_Y^{-1}(t)=f$ [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces]. Hence $c_P\circ F(t)=\operatorname{tr}_X(F(f)\circ\mu^{-1}_{L,M})$.
